headline: All Hail King Jesus: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: All Hail King Jesus is projected #8 of 16 with a 625.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Amon-Ra St. Brown, and Tee Higgins. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core. On the website's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #14 of 16 with a 712.0 dynasty power score.
